title: Homomorphisms of Hecke-Kiselman Monoids Associated to Simple Oriented Graphs
summary: Let $Γ$ and $Θ$ be finite simple oriented graphs, and let $\mathbf{HK}_Γ$ and $\mathbf{HK}_Θ$ denote the corresponding Hecke-Kiselman monoids. We present a set of Boolean matrices that is in bijection with the set of monoid homomorphisms from $\mathbf{HK}_Γ$ to $\mathbf{HK}_Θ$. In particular, we obtain a Boolean matrix monoid isomorphic to the endomorphism monoid of $\mathbf{HK}_Θ$.
